challenge_to_1.strongest_feature: The acquired-capability claim is closely tied to Egorov and the training photograph. It celebrates a real educational step.
challenge_to_1.risk: Demanding findings that existing data could not supply is stronger than the evidence warrants. Replication or independent comparison may be useful even when the question already has public data.
challenge_to_1.required_refinement: Test whether local collection supports the chosen task, not whether every result is unprecedented. Keep generalization conditional on the eventual claim.

challenge_to_2.strongest_feature: The clearest and warmest thesis: the student can shape data collection around a question. Different planned tasks give the second movement concrete substance.
challenge_to_2.risk: A visual reversal from an imported recording to an owned task could imply public data had prevented meaningful research. Egorov already presented EEG transfer-learning work.
challenge_to_2.required_refinement: State that this adds an experimental option to existing work. Do not describe all prior UAA research as data-dependent or treat public datasets as inferior.

self_challenge_to_3.risk: My new-participant thesis shifts the main subject toward an evaluation design UAA never announced. It risks turning a real capability win into an unsolicited methods lesson.
self_challenge_to_3.resolution: Do not choose proposal 3 as the headline thesis. Retain one short conditional validation line in Act 3 if needed. No data-leakage allegation and no numerical methods-study comparison.

recommended_synthesis.thesis: UAA has added a way for students to make EEG recordings around their own research tasks, expanding an AI practice that already used public data.
recommended_synthesis.earned_opinion: That is a meaningful Alaska research investment because it gives students control over an additional part of the experiment, before any result exists.
recommended_synthesis.falsifying_observation: If this instrument cannot produce usable recordings for the intended tasks, the claimed expansion of experimental capability fails. Documented local task data is the next test; a successful classifier is a later and separate test.
recommended_synthesis.second_movement: Move from Egorov observing a signal to the distinct planned reading and programming questions. The same measurement acquires meaning through task design.
recommended_synthesis.fair_counterpoint: Public data already made useful research possible. Local data does not become better simply by being collected locally; it adds choice and supports independent tests.
recommended_synthesis.act3_refinement: For a future claim about unfamiliar people, reserve people outside training. Introduce this as the standard a claim would need to meet, not an announced UAA plan.
recommended_synthesis.valence: Warm celebration of experimental agency; curiosity about the experiments ahead
recommended_synthesis.selection: Prefer proposal 2 structure, proposal 1 boundaries, proposal 3 only as a conditional evaluation sentence.
